description: Call this first, except for make_cartoon. One topic of the guide as Markdown: start (what it makes, the order of calls, every topic), cartoon (the JSON program), text (a cartoon as screenplay text), song (the editor's film file), build (the 3D builder), export, minecraft, world (a 3D world built from inside), game, motion (movement as words). x and y are shares of the stage (0 to 1, ground 0.92); times are seconds. Example: {"topic": "cartoon"}.

topic.description: Leave it out for start, which names the others.

name: get_guide
title: Read Jabbertoon's guide for writing a cartoon
